description: This file defines two interfaces, IReentrantStressTestGrain and IReentrantLocalStressTestGrain, which specify asynchronous methods for stress testing reentrant grains in Orleans. Methods include echoing data, retrieving runtime instance ID, and various ping methods with mutable and immutable data structures, as well as interleaving tests.
external_methods: Task PingMutableArray(byte[] data, long nextGrain, bool nextGrainIsRemote)
Task PingImmutableArray(Immutable<byte[]> data, long nextGrain, bool nextGrainIsRemote)
Task PingMutableDictionary(Dictionary<int, string> data, long nextGrain, bool nextGrainIsRemote)
Task PingImmutableDictionary(Immutable<Dictionary<int, string>> data, long nextGrain, bool nextGrainIsRemote)

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Echoes back the provided byte array data asynchronously.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime instance identifier as a string asynchronously.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs a ping operation with the provided byte array data.

methods.name: PingWithDelay
methods.description: Performs a ping operation with a delay specified by the TimeSpan.

methods.name: PingMutableArray
methods.description: Sends a mutable byte array and information about the next grain, remotely or locally.

methods.name: PingImmutableArray
methods.description: Sends an immutable byte array with info about next grain.

methods.name: PingMutableDictionary
methods.description: Sends a mutable dictionary with info about next grain.

methods.name: PingImmutableDictionary
methods.description: Sends an immutable dictionary with info about next grain.

methods.name: InterleavingConsistencyTest
methods.description: Performs a test to check interleaving consistency with a specified number of items.
